name: Accumulative Swing Index Lead
note: Wilder's Swing Index scores the QUALITY of each bar from its close against its own open and against the previous bar's open and close, divided by the largest bar-to-bar gap. Buys when the cumulative quality series (ASI) makes a new N-bar high while raw price has NOT taken out its N-bar high - buyers winning the bars without yet winning the level - and mirrors for shorts. The price leg is the published one (close vs the prior N-bar highest high), so it removes only the already-confirmed breakouts; the family therefore fires often and lives or dies on the ASI leg.
source: TradingView open-source: 'Accumulative Swing Index' by everget (original: J. Welles Wilder, 'New Concepts in Technical Trading Systems'). Exact Pine read from github.com/everget/tradingview-pinescript-indicators/blob/master/oscillators/accumulative_swing_index.pine . The ASI-leads-price entry condition is my specification of Wilder's ASI-breakout concept.

def _roll_max(v, w):
    from collections import deque
    n = len(v)
    out = [None] * n
    dq = deque()
    for j in range(n):
        x = v[j]
        while dq and v[dq[-1]] <= x:
            dq.pop()
        dq.append(j)
        while dq[0] <= j - w:
            dq.popleft()
        if j >= w - 1:
            out[j] = v[dq[0]]
    return out


def _roll_min(v, w):
    from collections import deque
    n = len(v)
    out = [None] * n
    dq = deque()
    for j in range(n):
        x = v[j]
        while dq and v[dq[-1]] >= x:
            dq.pop()
        dq.append(j)
        while dq[0] <= j - w:
            dq.popleft()
        if j >= w - 1:
            out[j] = v[dq[0]]
    return out


def family_init(ctx):
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    o = [float(b["o"]) for b in bars]
    h = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    l = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    t = float(ctx.p.limit_t)
    if t <= 0:
        t = 10000.0

    asi = [0.0] * n
    for j in range(1, n):
        c1, o1 = c[j - 1], o[j - 1]
        a = abs(h[j] - c1)
        b = abs(l[j] - c1)
        e = h[j] - l[j]
        k = a if a > b else b
        q = 0.25 * abs(c1 - o1)
        if a >= b and a >= e:
            rr = a - 0.5 * b + q
        elif b >= a and b >= e:
            rr = b - 0.5 * a + q
        else:
            rr = e + q
        if rr <= 0:
            si = 0.0
        else:
            si = 50.0 * ((c[j] - c1 + 0.5 * (c[j] - o[j]) + 0.25 * (c1 - o1))
                         / rr) * (k / t)
        asi[j] = asi[j - 1] + si

    sl = max(2, int(ctx.p.swing_lb))
    pl = max(2, int(ctx.p.price_lb))
    el = max(2, int(ctx.p.exit_lb))
    ctx.asi = ctx.series(asi, "asi")
    ctx.amax = ctx.series(_roll_max(asi, sl), "asi_max")
    ctx.amin = ctx.series(_roll_min(asi, sl), "asi_min")
    ctx.hmax = ctx.series(_roll_max(h, pl), "price_max")
    ctx.lmin = ctx.series(_roll_min(l, pl), "price_min")
    ctx.xmax = ctx.series(_roll_max(asi, el), "asi_exit_max")
    ctx.xmin = ctx.series(_roll_min(asi, el), "asi_exit_min")


def signal(ctx, i):
    if i < 2:
        return 0
    a = ctx.asi[i]
    am, an = ctx.amax[i - 1], ctx.amin[i - 1]
    hm, lm = ctx.hmax[i - 1], ctx.lmin[i - 1]
    c = ctx.c[i]
    if None in (a, am, an, hm, lm, c):
        return 0
    # ASI leads: quality accumulation breaks out, price has not
    if a > am and c <= hm:
        return 1
    if a < an and c >= lm:
        return -1
    return 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions or i < 2:
        return False
    a = ctx.asi[i]
    if a is None:
        return False
    long_ = ctx.positions[0]["side"] == "long"
    if long_:
        x = ctx.xmin[i - 1]
        if x is not None and a < x:
            return True
        hm = ctx.hmax[i - 1]
        h, c = ctx.h[i], ctx.c[i]
        # thesis realised: price finally makes the high, then closes back under
        if None not in (hm, h, c) and h > hm and c < hm:
            return True
        return False
    x = ctx.xmax[i - 1]
    if x is not None and a > x:
        return True
    lm = ctx.lmin[i - 1]
    l, c = ctx.l[i], ctx.c[i]
    if None not in (lm, l, c) and l < lm and c > lm:
        return True
    return False
